title: OAuth Authorization Server Metadata
description: The RFC 8414 metadata the Company's auth.issuer publishes, with the fields Poppy requires. Spec section 3.2 (OAuth server). Other fields are allowed, and Personal Agents ignore them. grant_types_supported says which of Direct and Device Sign-In the Company offers: authorization_endpoint is required when it includes authorization_code, and device_authorization_endpoint when it includes the device_code grant. scopes_supported is required when the Company offers any type of sign-in, which can depend on poppy.json. These are checked separately.

dpop_signing_alg_values_supported.description: Optional. The JWS algorithms the Company accepts for DPoP Proofs (RFC 9449 section 5.1). When present, it must include ES256, which is checked separately.

grant_types_supported.description: Must include urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer and refresh_token, which is checked separately.

protected_resources.description: RFC 9728 section 4. Lists https://{domain} for every domain whose poppy.json names the issuer, and may list other resources.
